name: @lunardraw/contract
description: Lunardraw's Starfall contract (7 from 35 + a Moonball from 20) for Midnight, with Nightcast's VRF embedded, plus an in-memory simulator.

scripts.compact: compact compile src/lunardraw.compact src/managed/lunardraw && compact compile --skip-zk src/settlement.compact src/managed/settlement
scripts.compact:fast: compact compile --skip-zk src/lunardraw.compact src/managed/lunardraw && compact compile --skip-zk src/settlement.compact src/managed/settlement
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && cp -R src/managed dist/managed && cp src/*.compact dist/
